description: Patent filings, grants, legal events, oppositions and expiries for your targets, assignees and own families, with sources. One table of patent families, an events feed with a calendar of expiries in the next 24 months, and a monthly scan + digest and high-impact alert run by Claude or ChatGPT. Not legal advice.
whenToUse: Keep an eye on patents around your targets and competitors: new publications and grants, legal events, oppositions and expiries in the next 24 months, and your own families, with a monthly digest.
whenNotToUse: Freedom-to-operate or validity opinions, patent drafting or prosecution, docketing official deadlines for your own filings, licensing deals (Deal Radar), legal advice.
